name: setregid32
description: setregid32 sets the real and/or effective group ID of the calling process, allowing specification of new values with -1 to leave unchanged. It is used for 32-bit group IDs and follows similar rules to setregid for privileges and behavior.

parameters.name: rgid
parameters.description: The new real group ID, or -1 to leave unchanged

parameters.name: egid
parameters.description: The new effective group ID, or -1 to leave unchanged

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The call would change the caller’s real GID with a temporary failure or resource limit issue
One or more of the target group IDs is not valid in this user namespace
The calling process is not privileged and a disallowed change was specified
